diagrams.title: HTTP request lifecycle
diagrams.caption: HTTP request lifecycle with all error paths
diagrams.source:
sequenceDiagram autonumber participant C as Client participant MW as Backend middlewares participant AH as ActionHandler participant RH as RequestHandler participant AI as ActionInvoker participant S as Action method C->>MW: GET /typo3/api/my-extension/page/42/titles alt backend session cookie Note over MW: Backend authentication
scopes: all allowed for the user else no cookie (EXT:hub) Note over MW: Validate app token
scopes: those of the token end MW->>AH: handle(request) alt no valid token AH-->>C: 401 Missing access token end AH->>RH: handle(request) alt required scope not granted RH-->>C: 403 Missing scope end alt invalid or missing argument RH-->>C: 400 error message end RH->>AI: invoke(action, arguments, context) AI->>S: titles(uid: 42, context) alt declared error S-->>RH: NotFoundError RH-->>C: 404 Page not found end S-->>AI: result alt result does not match the output schema AI-->>C: 500 invalid result end AI-->>RH: validated result RH-->>C: 200 JSON (204 if empty)

diagrams.title: MCP tool calls
diagrams.caption: An MCP tool call inside the action mcp
diagrams.intro: The MCP server is the action `mcp` (`POST /typo3/api/mcp`, scope `mcp`). TYPO3 authenticates, checks the scopes and validates a call to the action `mcp` like any other call. The action `mcp` then calls the requested tool through the same `ActionInvoker`.
diagrams.source:
sequenceDiagram autonumber participant A as AI client participant H as EXT:hub participant API as Action API participant M as Action mcp participant I as ActionInvoker participant D as Action dashboards A->>H: POST /typo3/api/mcp (tools/call fetch_dashboards) Note over H: Validate OAuth token
user + granted scopes H->>API: request Note over API: Scope mcp granted API->>I: invoke mcp I->>M: JSON-RPC message Note over M: Tool only available if
dashboard:read is granted M->>I: invoke dashboards I->>D: call method as the user D-->>I: result I-->>M: validated result M-->>API: JSON-RPC result API-->>A: 200 structuredContent

status_codes.cause: Success, or `204` if the action returns nothing
A missing argument, invalid JSON or a value that does not match the input schema
The token lacks a needed scope, or the action throws `PermissionDeniedError`
The action throws `NotFoundError`, or the route is unknown
The result does not match the output schema

mcp.behaviour: All actions whose scopes the token grants. The tool list leaves out every action with the scope `mcp`, also the action `mcp`.
`structuredContent`. TYPO3 wraps a result that is not an object as `{"data": …}`.

The JSON-RPC error “invalid params” (`-32602`) for invalid arguments, an unknown tool or a tool with a missing scope. The JSON-RPC error “internal error” (`-32603`) for a result that does not match the output schema. A tool result with `isError` for an error of the action.
